- Throughput: steady-state 3-4k infer/sec, spikes to 8-10k during batch recon cycles.
- Cost sensitivity: high — finance wants predictable unit economics before committing to 12-month reserved capacity.
- Model preferences: open heavy model family (Llama-3 equivalents), ability to pin to quantized variants; fallback policy to hosted small models during maintenance.

- Security/compliance: SSO (SAML), enterprise KMS for key wrapping, SOC2 required, audit logging retention 7 years for selected logs, data residency in SG for APAC traffic.
